headline: Dandilord world tree helper
title: Dandilord | Planting Eight And Poison Immunity | Palworld Guide
video_script: Planting level eight is huge. Dandilord has it, plus Handiwork level six, Medicine level six, Gathering level five and Transporting level three. Its partner skill, Mist Stalwart, gives you and your party immunity to Poison and cancels toxic gas effects in the World Tree area. A top farm worker and a World Tree helper. Will you bring Dandilord to the World Tree? Comment below!
description: Dandilord in Palworld 1.0 has Planting level eight and a partner skill that gives Poison immunity and cancels World Tree toxic gas.
